name: Kitewell

overview: Kitewell is a three-bedroom self-catering house at Trebrowen near Angle, on the peninsula west of Freshwater West. It sleeps seven, has an enclosed garden with a hot tub, and the beach is roughly five minutes away by car.
surfTripFit: A short drive puts you at Freshwater West for early sessions, and the hot tub and enclosed garden make it an easy group base between surfs.
